semantics.sampling: All DFFs triggered by positive edge of clk, as explicitly stated in problem.txt; updates visible after nonblocking assignment settlement.
semantics.reset: Synchronous active-low reset as explicitly stated: at posedge with resetn=0, clear all 16 bits, overriding byte enables.
semantics.write: At posedge with resetn=1, byteena[1] writes d[15:8] to q[15:8]; byteena[0] writes d[7:0] to q[7:0]. Disabled bytes retain state.
semantics.between_edges: No state updates on input changes or falling edges.
semantics.initialization: No power-up value specified; no DUT initialization. Unwritten bits remain unknown in four-state simulation until reset or enabled write.
semantics.latency: The sampled data updates q on that same rising edge, with no extra cycle.

numeric.reset_value: 16'h0000 (interpretation of reset; value not explicitly stated)

verification.oracle: Independent per-bit state model from original reset and byte-enable descriptions
verification.sampling: Drive away from rising edges; compare after NBA settlement
verification.failure: $fatal on mismatch and bounded timeout; PASS only at successful completion

specification_ambiguities.issue: Reset value is not explicitly stated
specification_ambiguities.resolution: Interpret reset of all DFFs as clearing q to zero; reset takes precedence over byte enables.
No initialization imposed; test unknown retention before any defining edge in simulation.
